question: Does learning one shared orthonormal 2x3 depth basis from normal frames improve seven-scene AUC over fixed mean/trend rank2?
limitations: One seed 42 can diagnose this isolated ablation but not establish cross-seed stability.
The trainable six raw coefficients are orthonormalized in the forward pass; effective degrees of freedom are lower than six.
AUC and normal-feature energy can disagree; normal-feature energy alone is not an anomaly metric.
